selection_rules.external_pairs: Select every pair in each required technology that has >=500 units per slice and >=4 common non-missing public labels; pair selection uses metadata only.
selection_rules.downsampling: Stratified by public label with deterministic seed 20260716; labels are never supplied to a solver.
selection_rules.no_posthoc: Registered v1.2 outcomes and thresholds remain immutable. Version 1.3 corrects implementation/statistical defects and labels all newly selected intervention-specific hypotheses exploratory until independent replication.

v1_3_correction.direction_aggregation: average within biological pair before cross-pair inference
v1_3_correction.risk_tie_handling: fractional tie blocks for risk-coverage and top-fraction overlap
v1_3_correction.independent_unit_rule: cross-stage Stereo-seq pairs form one shared developmental-series unit
v1_3_correction.claim_status: audit protocol and failure-boundary analysis; not a new OT solver
